rationale: Localized correctness fix in the Codex policy-rejection scan: after the 32KB tail bound, drop the truncated first line unless the window starts on a line boundary, and pass the full combined tail through the streaming watcher so boundary detection sees the byte before the window. Small surface (one new helper plus two call-site tweaks) but subtle window-boundary and streaming edge cases; two regression tests cover no-false-kill and genuine-rejection-still-detected.
